name: Denalan's Earth
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Are you heading to the south?  To Lake Al'Ameth?  If so, then I have a task I might ask of you...

My colleague Denalan has a camp along the eastern end of the lake, where he is studying and experimenting on the plant life of Teldrassil.  He requested a package of rare earths from Darnassus and it was late, only recently arriving here in Dolanaar.

Can you take the package to him?
narrative.objectives: Bring the package of Rare Earth to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, it's here! I have waited for this rare earth for quite some time. I hope it's still fresh...

Thank you for bringing it to me, adventurer. You are a friend who is generous with his time.
